criteria.text: Tap writes a response row and its event row in one transaction; count updates
criteria.note: Table and event kinds exist; no action, RPC or button. Feed `response_count` reads rows with `withdrawn_at is null` (`016_discoverable_items.sql`) but nothing ever inserts. #34

criteria.text: Tap again withdraws, no dialog; double-tap is a no-op enforced by a database constraint
criteria.note: `withdrawn_at` column exists; no unique constraint on (item_id, responder_member_id, kind) in any migration [V grep]. #34

criteria.text: A signed-out tap survives sign-in and is recorded on return
criteria.note: Generic `/auth/login?next=` return exists; nothing carries a pending response through it. #34

criteria.text: Count is distinct people, never rows
criteria.note: Count is `count(*)` over rows, not distinct responders, and with no unique constraint duplicates are possible (`016_discoverable_items.sql`, `20261007020000_archived_pages_every_path.sql`). Builder responses are excluded in the newer one. #34
